tldr: Kickoff meeting for a remote control design project, run by Sarah, the project manager.
Sarah covered the agenda: getting acquainted, tool training, project plan, and individual ideas, within twenty-five minutes.
Product goals: original, trendy, wide market appeal, user friendly, and not a hunk of metal.
Design runs in three stages: functional, conceptual, then detailed design.
The team began a whiteboard warm-up. Sarah drew a tiger and called it majestic, independent and proud. Harry was about to draw his animal when the transcript ends.
questions: What animal is Harry drawing? He asked the others to guess.
